{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS112 |prevtitle=Raise the Red Gyarados |nextcode=PS114 |nexttitle=Delibird Delivery - 2 |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Delibird Delivery - 1 |title_ja=VS デリバードI |title_ro=VS Delibird I |image=PS113.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 113 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|9}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 113 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|9}} |location=[[Lake of Rage]] }} '''Delibird Delivery - 1''' (Japanese: '''VS デリバードI''' ''VS Delibird I''), titled '''VS Delibird 1''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 113th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 23rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} After seeing the [[Masked Man]], {{adv|Gold}} immediately has his [[Polibo]] use {{m|Dynamic Punch}}, but Polibo's hand is {{status|Freeze|Frozen}}. Then Gold charges forward, but {{adv|Silver}} pushes him backward and has his {{p|Kingdra}} use {{m|Twister}} so that Gold can see the ice spikes that were hidden by the mist. Suddenly, [[Professor Elm]] calls Gold on his [[Pokégear]]. He tells Gold that evidence says that the Masked Man is a [[Gym Leader]], and to not fight the Masked Man. But Gold is in the middle of doing exactly that. The Masked Man's {{p|Delibird}} uses {{m|Blizzard}}, creating more ice spikes. The Masked Man says that Silver can't run away from him "like last time". Silver and his {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}} seem aggravated. Sneasel then uses {{m|Icy Wind}}. Delibird feints at Gold, then punches Silver in the face. The Masked Man steps on Silver's hand to hold him where he is. Gold finds out that the Masked Man kidnapped kids nine years ago, and one of them was Silver. Silver prepares to send out a Pokémon, but the Masked Man tells Silver that if he does that, he'll kill Gold since his Delibird's arm is frozen to make an ice spear. The Masked Man tells Silver that he's gone weak. However, Gold knows the truth and tells the Masked Man that Silver is strong and that he has seen Silver's strength many times. Then [[Exbo]] throws Delibird off its feet. Silver and Sneasel get a bit farther away from the Masked Man. The Masked Man sends out his {{p|Houndour}} and his {{p|Ariados}}. ==Major events== * {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Silver}} fight against the [[Masked Man]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Green}} (silhouette) * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * [[Masked Man]] * [[Professor Elm]] * [[Bugsy]] (silhouette) * [[Falkner]] (silhouette) * [[Whitney]] (silhouette) * [[Morty]] (silhouette) * [[Jasmine]] (silhouette) * [[Karen]] (silhouette) * [[Will]] (silhouette) * [[Sham]] (silhouette) * [[Carl]] (silhouette) * [[Joey]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Politoed}} ([[Polibo]], {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Quilava}} ([[Exbo]], {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Sneasel}} ({{OP|Silver|Sneasel}}) * {{p|Kingdra}} ({{adv|Silver}}'s) * {{p|Sentret}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Delibird}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Houndour}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Ariados}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Gyarados}} (multiple; silhouette and flashback) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}; statue; flashback) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, {{adv|Silver}}'s {{p|Kingdra}} is mistakenly referred to as Kingora. * In the Chuang Yi version, when {{adv|Gold}}'s [[Exbo]] and [[Silver's Sneasel]] attack, Sneasel is called [[Polibo|Politaro]]. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 信使鳥 ①|VS Delibird 1}} (Taiwan)
